page0.text:
And...
...after giving me several medications, Tohsaka instructs me to do simple Strengthening exercises while we keep an eye on how my body reacts.
Apparently she's checking to see that nothing goes wrong inside me when I use magical energy.
Honestly, Tohsaka seems more like a doctor more than a teacher today.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page0:1

page1.text:
"Okay. There don't seem to be any problems. You probably don't need to come here tomorrow, then."
"Eh?"
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page1:1

page2.text:
That's a bit of a surprise.
I don't have to come tomorrow...that means...
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page2:1

page3.text:
"Yep. There's nothing else I can teach you. If you want to focus on learning magecraft, you should do it after the war.
Besides with Archer gone, my alliance with you is long over."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page3:1

page4.text:
"Wha...?"
I suddenly realize.
Our alliance was only so we could defeat Berserker.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page4:1

page5.text:
Now that Berserker's gone, and Tohsaka doesn't have a Servant anymore...
...our living arrangement should be over. Should have ended yesterday, even.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page5:1

page6.text:
"So what are you going to do now, Tohsaka? Are you going to go to Kotomine's place?"
That'd probably be the normal thing to do.
Tohsaka and Father Kotomine are student and disciple, so it shouldn't be an issue for her to go asking him for protection.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page6:1

page7.text:
"Why? Of course I'm not going there. I haven't lost yet. There's no reason I can't fight without a Servant.
Besides, running away isn't really my style. I decided to fight, so I'm seeing this through to the end."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page7:1

page8.text:
She says this like it should be the most obvious thing in the world.
And she's proud about that.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page8:1

page9.text:
...
My eyes widen.
Well, okay, maybe not.
I should have expected this from Tohsaka.
She's unbelievably stubborn...
...absolutely selfish...
...and captivatingly brilliant.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page9:1

page10.text:
"Then what are you going to do? Are you going to go out on your own now?
There are still Servants and Masters left."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page10:1

page11.text:
"Let's see... I think I'll stay here awhile to gather information.
I should resume my research on Ryudou Temple too."
"You're going to stay here...? A-are you sure!?
It'd be a big help if you stayed, but our alliance ended, so..."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page11:1

page12.text: "What are you talking about? We managed to beat Berserker thanks to Archer. Our alliance may have ended, but you still owe me. And that's why you're obviously going to let me use your place until you've fully repaid your debt."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page12:1

page13.text:
"Besides. I said I would take responsibility until the end.
You and I were teacher and student, even if it was brief. I'd be so worried about you if I left you to your devices, I wouldn't be able to concentrate on the Holy Grail War."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page13:1

page14.text:
...
Oh right.
It feels like a lifetime ago, so I'd nearly forgotten, but I've admired Rin because of exactly those qualities for a long time now.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page14:1

page15.text:
So I'm actually very happy.
That's the Tohsaka I've always known and liked.
Besides, if I ever saw the day a girl as stubborn as her gives up, I wouldn't know what to believe from then on.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page15:1

page16.text:
"Yeah. Thanks for sticking around, Tohsaka.
Whatever else I might say, I wouldn't know what to do without you. Saber and I need you, Tohsaka."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page16:1

page17.text: "That's fine. But don't say stuff like that. You're stupidly honest, yeah, but be careful about what you say. You could give people the wrong idea."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page17:1

page18.text:
"Huh?"
I'm not sure why that upset Tohsaka so much.
"Tohsaka, what do you mean I might give people the wrong idea? What wrong idea?"
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page18:1

page19.text:
"Unbelievable. It just wasn't appropriate, okay? And my whole attitude should make clear I don't want you asking, so drop it."
Uh...
Tohsaka must be aware of some secret rule I'm not.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page19:1

page20.text:
"Good grief. I feel bad... Saber's got it tough.
But then again, that's probably why you two work. You and Saber both have to be pretty freakin' dense, or else you'd never last."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page20:1

page21.text: "Hmmm. Okay, I still don't get it, but I didn't miss what you said about feeling bad for Saber. What do you mean she has it tough?"
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page21:1

page22.text: "This is exactly what I'm talking about. I bet you haven't even noticed the changes in Saber."
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page22:1

page23.text:
"Changes in Saber?"
It's not about her appearance...right?
If anything would have changed in Saber...
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page23:1

page24.text:
"Oh right. She has been acting weird since this morning...
No, I just thought she was in a bad mood because Illya was with us. She just sat there, all stiff and quiet, and when I asked if there was something wrong, she just got up and left, saying something about having had a dream."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page24:1

page25.text:
And I pretty much forgot about it in all the hustle and bustle over Illya.
Yeah, Saber's been a little off since this morning, like her head is somewhere else.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page25:1

page26.text:
"Saber said she had a dream?"
"Eh? That's the bit that surprises you?"
"..."
And now she's ignoring me.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page26:1

page27.text:
"Hey. Don't go quiet on me. That face you're making has me nervous."
"Eh? Oh, it's nothing major.
It's just that Servants don't typically dream."
Huh?
Servants don't...dream?
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page27:1

page28.text:
"That's right. Servants don't dream.
But if she says she did, then it wasn't a dream. It was someone's memory."
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page28:1

page29.text:
Maybe Tohsaka's experienced it before.
The coldness in her voice runs so counter to her usual cheerfulness.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十二日目-11:page29:1
